title: Generate
lead: Each shot gets a few takes, auto QA scores them, and you just pick. Rerun or switch models when you are not happy — older takes are kept.

cards.label: Queues and QA
cards.shotCap: Per-shot cap {{cap}}; above it you are asked first
cards.fallbacks: {{count}} local jobs fell back to the API
cards.waiting: {{count}} jobs wait for you to confirm the cost

wall.label: Takes
wall.title: Takes for shot {{id}}
wall.keys: ← → switch takes · Space play · 1–5 rate · A adopt
wall.redrawn: The check failed; made again with what failed, this one passed after {{count}} more tries.
wall.redrawnStill: The check failed and still fails after {{count}} more tries; this is the try with the fewest problems: only a warning, it can be adopted.
wall.noDialogue: Nobody speaks in this shot, so there are no lips to repair

note.fallback_timeout: Local timed out, fell back to API
note.auto_lip: Only the lips failed: lip-sync repair of T{{n}}

empty.running: {{model}} is making take {{n}}. It is checked automatically and then shows up here.
empty.queuedDub: The lines are voiced with the locked voice first, then the picture is generated.
empty.queuedText: On-screen text is added in post, so this take has no lettering.
empty.waiting: Waiting for {{id}} to be adopted: this shot starts from the last frame of {{id}}.
empty.none: No takes yet. Click “One more take” to start.

toast.adoptedWarn: {{id}}: adopted T{{n}} (note: {{fails}} QA checks failed; you chose to keep it).
toast.final: Making the 2K final of {{id}} T{{n}} on the API.
toast.upLocal: Sent {{id}} T{{n}} to 2K finishing ({{model}}); runs locally, no charge.
toast.lipLocal: Sent {{id}} T{{n}} to lip-sync repair ({{model}}); runs locally, no charge.
toast.lipApi: Sent {{id}} T{{n}} to lip-sync repair ({{model}}), est. {{cost}}.

rules.title: Auto rules
rules.retryBefore: When QA fails, rerun automatically up to
rules.retryAfter: times, then switch models per the fallback settings
rules.capBefore: When a shot would cost more than $
rules.qaLead: This series only; existing takes are judged again by the new limits, not measured again

note.lipsync: SyncNet score: how well it lines up within ±2 frames; dialogue shots only
note.asr: What is heard against the script's lines
note.speaker: Against the locked voice
note.vlm: Vision model against the contract and the continuity ledger

log.title: Run log
log.take_fail_fallback: {{model}} made T{{take}} · {{fails}} failed ({{issues}}) → reruns used up, falling back to {{to}}
log.take_fail_lip: {{model}} made T{{take}} · only lip sync failed → automatic lip-sync repair
log.take_fail_stop: {{model}} made T{{take}} · {{fails}} failed ({{issues}}) → the fallback failed too, stopped for you to look
log.switch_pass: You tried another model → {{model}} made T{{take}}{{cost}} · QA passed
log.switch_fail: You tried another model → {{model}} made T{{take}}{{cost}} · {{fails}} failed
log.fallback_timeout: Local job ran over {{minutes}} min → fell back to {{model}}
log.fallback_error: Local job failed → fell back to {{model}}
log.switch: You tried another model → {{model}} made T{{take}}{{cost}}
log.final: Final on the API → {{model}} made T{{take}}{{cost}}

policy.lip: Only the lips failed → sent to lip-sync repair
policy.stop: The fallback failed too: stopped for you to look, nothing more spent
policy.wait: The next try costs money: waiting for your yes
